description: This file is a unit test class for the QuickLaunchDao component within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It contains setup and multiple test methods that verify the behavior of getting quick launch item lists under different configurations.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for the QuickLaunchDao class, testing its methods for retrieving quick launch item lists based on different module configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test, instantiating QuickLaunchDao and setting the fixture directory, along with mocking services.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList1
methods.description: Tests retrieving the full quick launch list when modules are enabled and periods are defined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS1
methods.description: Tests getting the quick launch list for the Employee Self-Service (ESS) when modules are enabled and periods are defined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList2
methods.description: Tests retrieving an empty list when modules are enabled but periods are undefined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS2
methods.description: Tests retrieving an empty list for ESS when modules are enabled but periods are undefined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList3
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list when the leave module is disabled.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS3
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list for ESS when the leave module is disabled.
